in_marathi.name: Asvin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asvin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asvin are the horse-headed twin gods in Hindu mythology, Ashwins or the Ashvins. They are also known as the gods of health, herbs, and the stars. They are the physicians of the gods, the dispellers of diseases, and the purifiers of the atmosphere. They are also identified with the sun and the rain, which symbolizes their power to heal and revitalize.
